bills.title: Bills for this unit
bills.body: When the building issues a bill you'll get a LINE message, and you can see it here with a QR code to pay

noUnit.title: No unit on this account yet
noUnit.body: Ask your building's office for an invitation code, then enter it to link your unit

invoice.title: Bill for {period}
invoice.more: {count, plural, one {# more bill} other {# more bills}} to pay
invoice.nothingDueBody: You are all paid up. When a new bill is ready, you will hear about it in LINE.

linkPending.title: Waiting for the building's office to confirm
linkPending.body: Your mobile number matches {count, plural, one {a resident record} other {# resident records}} the building's office entered. To keep your account safe, the office first confirms that it is really you.
linkPending.hidden: Your bills, lease and door codes appear here once it is confirmed. Ask the office to confirm, then check again.
linkPending.invite: Have an invitation code? It links your unit at once, with no wait.
linkPending.more: {count, plural, one {One more record waits} other {# more records wait}} for the building's office to confirm it is you before it appears here.
linkPending.stillWaiting: Not confirmed yet — the office has not decided. This page updates by itself as soon as they do.

linkDeclined.title: The building's office did not confirm this sign-in
linkDeclined.body: The office declined to link your mobile number to the resident records it entered, so no unit was added to this account.
linkDeclined.next: If you live in this building, contact the building's office, or ask them for an invitation code — it links your unit at once.
